reviews.title: Incredibly Helpful
reviews.text: This app is incredibly helpful and has saved me hundreds of dollars.

reviews.title: Horrible
reviews.text: It took 3 days for EyeOnWater to alert me of a huge home leak while I was out of state. In 3 days 2000 gallons leaked and will be charged as consumption because this flawed program decided to sit on the information. Can I bill them for the equivalent of one months usage in my vacant home? No. There’s fine print that prevents that of course. Warning if you think you are protected … you are not. A lovely surprise for me just out of surgery with complications 2 days ago.

reviews.title: Helpful app
reviews.text: EyeOnWater app has saved us a lot of money and aggregation. Once it detected a leak and a plumber found a bad toilet ring. Then, twice my husband forgot to turn off the water faucet after washing his car 🙄 and this app helped us find it before wasting more water AND running up our bill even higher. I recommend the EyeOnWater app! Be sure to set up your preferred notification settings in the app after downloading it; the sooner you get them, the sooner you can fix the problem.

reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: Bill skyrocketed and the app has consistently read 0 gallons. Do not get forced into this madness without making sure the damn equipment works

reviews.title: Too complicated to understand
reviews.text: This app is too complicated to understand and analyze. For a normal literate person, how can you understand all the bar charts and data that are shown? Anything for public should be simple and clear to understand. Also the UI is not so friendly.

reviews.title: Saved me $$
reviews.text: I was sent a notice of excessive usage which caused me to check all possibilities and discovered our guest commode had a leaky valve trap. It has been replaced now without getting a horrendous water bill(time will verify that)and for that we are grateful

reviews.title: Eye on water quit working. Not giving me daily usage.
reviews.text: Was great but for two days I have not shown any water usage. What is the problem?

reviews.title: A good app for accurate reading of water usage
reviews.text: This app is simple and easy to use. I can easily see what my water usage is and it even helps determine is your line has a leak. Fortunately that has not happened to my line but others have reported that it works. I can quickly check to see my daily, weekly, monthly, and annual water usage. It helps me understand when to replace my whole house filter.

reviews.title: Confusing App
reviews.text: I like the idea of an app alerting me to possible issues but I don’t think they’ve got things quite right yet and getting help is nearly impossible. Example- if I run my sprinkler- it seems to compare to the prior week and indicate a leak but then if I don’t run it for a few days - that alert goes away so it doesn’t seem accurate.

reviews.title: Happy Review
reviews.text:
I think this is a fantastic app.  The city should focus on informing the residents that it’s available and encourage them to utilize it.
Thank you so much.

reviews.title: An eye opening reminder…
reviews.text: We’re at a moment where every household needs to take notice. Conservation isn’t a slogan — it’s a shared duty. A tool like EyeOnWater should be standard for every home, because it empowers people to do their part with clarity, not guesswork.

reviews.title: Saves Water and Money!
reviews.text: Got hit with a huge water bill last December and was shocked.   Turns out a toilet was leaking internally (directly into the overflow). Website allows you to drill down per hour to help troubleshoot! The Leak Alerts are awesome!!!

reviews.title: Lost connection
reviews.text: I’m having issues connecting to the hourly monitoring. It hasn’t been connected in 17 hours after many attempts to reboot and reinstall app.

reviews.title: Great App!
reviews.text: Helps me conserve water and lets me know if I have a leak in the system!

reviews.title: I’m more aware now
reviews.text: I am a very modest consumer of water. Always trying to consider the environment and the local water shortage in our community. This has made me way more aware and eye opening to how many gallons my family consumes per day. Between watering the lawn and consumption within the home. I check my app multiple times a day. It’s kind of like a video game to see how efficient we can become. Love this technology

reviews.title: why was my bill prior to the new system so high?
reviews.text: ever since they installed the new system of how they read your usage my water usage has went down by a third or more whereas my bill could run as much as 180 a month averaging now about 113 to 130 a month so seems to me like for so long we were overcharged by usage It seems like we should get some type of a refund because there’s no way without leaks or anything like that that my water usage can go down by that much and we haven’t did anything different than when our bills were around 180 so what gives I personally like this app?

reviews.title: CD any trust it.

The leak detection is nice but I'd rather to be able to see the small red indicator at the meter to see with my own eyes. That's more foolproof but it's locked and the water company doesn't want homeowners to have unrestricted access.

reviews.title: Leak alert

I understand that it may not be in real time … but maybe once it breached a certain amount of overage it would also alert a bit sooner. Thank you.
